criterion: Builds a complete native LibrePCB PCIe Gen 5 x1 channel with endpoint, TX pair, RX pair, connector, support signals, and no unexplained open nodes.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Open every schematic page and trace the complete PCIe channel and support interfaces.","assets":[],"explanation":"The end-to-end host-board architecture must be complete before layout validation."}

criterion: Uses an exact active PCIe Gen 5 endpoint and an approved high-speed connector with verified manufacturer models.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect the BOM, endpoint selection, connector data, and model index.","assets":[],"explanation":"Real package and connector characteristics dominate the extracted channel."}

criterion: Provides verified LibrePCB symbols, packages, devices, pin maps, courtyards, mask/paste data, and STEP models.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Cross-check every custom library element against manufacturer drawings and pin tables.","assets":[],"explanation":"Incorrect library geometry invalidates the high-speed layout."}

criterion: Places 220 nF AC-coupling capacitors only in the host transmit pair.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Trace TX and RX schematic nets and confirm one capacitor per TX conductor and no added RX capacitor.","assets":[],"explanation":"PCIe AC coupling belongs at the transmitting side of each direction."}

criterion: Uses one symmetric 0201 capacitor footprint per TX conductor in the production channel.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect both production capacitor footprints, orientation, pads, mask, and conductor symmetry.","assets":[],"explanation":"The production pattern must minimize the 16 GHz discontinuity."}

criterion: Places the production TX capacitors within the documented 25 mm project target from the transmitter launch.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Measure package-launch-to-capacitor distance along both conductors.","assets":[],"explanation":"Short placement reduces the unmatched pre-capacitor segment."}

criterion: Contains no 0-ohm resistor, common-mode choke, permanent test point, or alternate DNP branch in the production lane.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Trace the production TX and RX nets and inspect all component branches.","assets":[],"explanation":"Extra pads and stubs degrade PCIe Gen 5 return loss."}

criterion: Implements separate 0201, 0402, plane-relief, through-line, and de-embedding coupons rather than alternate production footprints.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect the coupon area and verify electrical separation from the production channel.","assets":[],"explanation":"Controlled coupons permit valid footprint comparison without harming the real lane."}

criterion: Uses a fabricator-confirmed low-loss stack-up with documented Dk, Df, copper, dielectric, and solder-mask values.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Review the stack-up drawing and solver inputs.","assets":[],"explanation":"Impedance and loss require the actual manufacturing stack-up."}

criterion: Routes all PCIe pairs at 85-ohm differential impedance using field-solver-approved geometry.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect net classes, impedance table, routing layers, and solver report.","assets":[],"explanation":"The PCIe channel requires controlled differential impedance."}

criterion: Keeps intra-pair length mismatch at 0.10 mm or less for both TX and RX pairs.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Read the final route-length and electrical-delay report.","assets":[],"explanation":"Low skew reduces mode conversion and eye closure."}

criterion: Uses identical via count, drill, pad, antipad, backdrill, and layer sequence within each pair.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect every positive and negative signal transition.","assets":[],"explanation":"Transition asymmetry creates differential-to-common-mode conversion."}

criterion: Uses no more than two signal transitions per conductor and limits residual via stubs to 0.30 mm.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Review via-count, drill, and backdrill reports.","assets":[],"explanation":"Via resonances can occur within the PCIe Gen 5 bandwidth."}

criterion: Places a ground stitching via within 1.0 mm of each signal-layer transition.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Measure the return-via distance at every transition.","assets":[],"explanation":"A nearby return path maintains high-frequency reference continuity."}

criterion: Routes every high-speed pair over a continuous solid reference plane without crossing splits or unapproved void boundaries.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect all routed layers and underlying reference planes.","assets":[],"explanation":"Reference discontinuities create impedance errors and mode conversion."}

criterion: Uses smooth symmetric tapers through the capacitor pads without abrupt width or spacing changes.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Inspect pad entry, pad exit, bends, and conductor symmetry.","assets":[],"explanation":"Smooth transitions mitigate the capacitor land-pattern discontinuity."}

criterion: Uses only solver-approved local reference-plane relief beneath the capacitor pads.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Compare the PCB void geometry with the field-solver report and fabrication drawing.","assets":[],"explanation":"Plane relief must reduce pad capacitance without creating a longer return-path discontinuity."}

criterion: Keeps PCIe pairs separated from switching, clock, high-current, board-edge, and chassis aggressors.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Measure spacing and inspect adjacent-layer routing along the complete channel.","assets":[],"explanation":"Physical isolation limits crosstalk and deterministic jitter."}

criterion: Keeps distributed production-channel TDR between 80.75 and 89.25 ohms outside identified local discontinuities.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Review the extracted differential TDR and marked regions.","assets":[],"explanation":"The board routing must remain within the project impedance tolerance."}

criterion: Keeps production-channel Sdd21 loss at or below 12 dB at 16 GHz.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Read the extracted production-channel insertion loss at 16 GHz.","assets":[],"explanation":"The production geometry must meet the defined loss budget."}

criterion: Keeps production-channel Sdd11 at or below -10 dB from 100 MHz to 16 GHz.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Inspect the extracted differential return-loss sweep.","assets":[],"explanation":"Return loss validates launches, pads, and termination transitions."}

criterion: Keeps production-channel Scd21 at or below -20 dB from 100 MHz to 16 GHz.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Inspect the extracted mode-conversion sweep.","assets":[],"explanation":"Mode conversion reveals differential asymmetry."}

criterion: Reduces peak local TDR deviation by 30% and improves the worst return-loss notch by 1.5 dB versus the 0402 coupon.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Compare 0201 and 0402 coupon TDR and Sdd11 results under identical de-embedding.","assets":[],"explanation":"The optimized footprint must demonstrate quantified improvement."}

criterion: Achieves at least 100 mV eye height and 0.35 UI eye width for the extracted equalized production channel.
forms: {"type":"Visual check","assessment_process":"Review the final eye report and documented transmitter, receiver, jitter, and noise assumptions.","assets":[],"explanation":"The extracted layout must produce a usable project-level eye opening."}

criterion: Passes ERC and DRC and submits all native project, manufacturing, model, coupon, S-parameter, TDR, and review files without manual repair.
forms: {"type":"In-application check","assessment_process":"Open the release package on a clean LibrePCB setup, run checks and Output Jobs, and reproduce the submitted evidence.","assets":[],"explanation":"Independent acceptance requires a complete rule-clean and portable project."}
